primary_task: Route a cross-domain IT operations task (e.g. AD audit, Azure VM deployment) to specialist agents and merge a unified plan or script.

requirements.name: sub-agents
requirements.evidence: 'dispatch the work to the most appropriate specialists'; 'Assign each sub-problem to the correct agent'
requirements.basis: agent: start sub-agents that work in parallel, send them messages and list them

requirements.name: named specialist agents (powershell-5.1-expert, azure-infra-engineer, ...)
requirements.basis: The manifest says sub-agents can be started; it does not say these named agents are installed. Need to check the agent/skill list.

requirements.name: Windows / on-prem AD, DNS, DHCP, GPO
requirements.evidence: 'Infra experts (AD, DNS, DHCP, GPO, on-prem Windows)'; 'The environment is Windows or hybrid'
requirements.basis: lacks: Windows or macOS, and their GUI toolchains (Xcode, Visual Studio, PowerShell on Windows)

requirements.name: Azure / M365 / Graph API
requirements.basis: lacks: accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, SaaS products, model hubs, app stores, email delivery, payment)

notes: Primary task is routing and merging text; execution against AD or Azure is not a stated must. If the request required running PowerShell against a Windows domain, it would be BLOCKED.
